historical_record.description: The property held an existing 56,250-gross-square-foot, three-story light-industrial building.
The City Planning Commission upheld the Preliminary Mitigated Negative Declaration for the proposed 155,000-square-foot, 8-story residential building with 82 dwelling units at 40-50 Lansing Street.

The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization for an 84-foot building with up to 82 dwelling units, as amended with move-in, traffic, car-share, and unbundled-parking conditions.
